summary: All 23 SRanger requirements are implemented in 9 Java files under sranger/ (annotation, event, controller, sensor, actuator). One controller, SRangerController, with modes MOVING (initial), TURNING, FINAL and a single step(InputEvent). Nine points the requirements did not settle are listed below; none blocks the pipeline.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading distance is 1000.0 m; negative or NaN readings count as no reading
issues.raw: SR-DM5 asks for 'a large default value' when no reading is available but gives no number, and says distance() is non-negative without saying what to do with an invalid measurement.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 m (far above the 0.5 m threshold and any IR range) or supply the intended value; confirm that an invalid (negative/NaN) measurement should reset to the no-reading value rather than keep the last valid reading.

issues.title: Actuator reports (0, 0) before any command
issues.raw: SR-DM6 says the Actuator stores the latest command but not what it reports before the first command.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm that a stopped command (lv = 0, av = 0) is the right initial value.

issues.title: Initial Move(moveVel, 0) is issued in the controller constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1 says Moving's entry issues Move(moveVel, 0) and SR-Beh1 says the controller starts in Moving; step() has no initial transition, and the tick self-loop performs no action (SR-Beh4), so without a power-up command the robot would never start driving.
issues.fix_directive: The constructor issues the entry command once at power-up. The extractor may not carry this into the model's initial transition; that does not affect deadlock or divergence freedom.

issues.title: Tick self-loops perform no action and do not repeat the entry actions
issues.raw: SR-Beh4/SR-Beh7 say the controller performs no action on the tick self-transition; the profile rule says each branch performs the target's entry actions, and in RoboChart a self-transition re-enters the state. Repeating Turning's entry on every tick would reset clockResetTime each cycle, so Turning would never end.
issues.fix_directive: The tick branches only reassign the same mode. The explicit requirement wins over the generic rule.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning uses both the obstacle event and the obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 says the transition fires when the obstacle event is received; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is its guard; SR-DM3 says the event is emitted when the distance crosses below the threshold (strictly).
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as trigger obstacle with condition obstacleDetected (<=, as SR-GP1 states). An obstacle event with a reading above the threshold is ignored.

issues.title: Turning priority: endTask, then turnDurationElapsed, then tick (guarded by !turnDurationElapsed)
issues.raw: The requirements give no priority between the autonomous Turning -> Moving transition and the tick self-loop. A tick arrives every cycle, so if tick came first the timed transition would never fire on a tick cycle.
issues.fix_directive: endTask (stop) is first; the autonomous transition precedes tick, and the tick branch conjoins !turnDurationElapsed as the profile requires below a predicate-only branch.

issues.title: Where and in which order clockResetTime is set
issues.raw: SR-Var1 calls the reset 'an entry action on the Moving -> Turning transition'; SR-Beh2 lists 'set clockResetTime ... and issue Move(0, turnVel)'; SR-FR2 lists the Move first.
issues.fix_directive: Turning is entered only from Moving, so the reset is done in the Moving -> Turning branch, before Move(0, turnVel), in SR-Beh2's order. The reset uses Clock.now() held in a field named timer ('clock' is reserved).

issues.title: obstacleThreshold 0.5 rounds up to 1 in the model's constants interface
issues.raw: The profile rounds fractional constants up to an integer in the model; OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD = 0.5 is used by the obstacleDetected guard, so the model's guard reads distance() <= 1. The other constants (1.0, 2.0, 2.0) are integral.
issues.fix_directive: The Java keeps the specified 0.5 m. The model's threshold differs; deadlock and divergence freedom do not depend on it.

issues.title: Events with no specified transition are ignored; Final has no outgoing transitions
issues.raw: No requirement covers obstacle in Turning, or any event in Final.
issues.fix_directive: Such events leave the mode unchanged. Final is a terminal mode with an empty block.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, FDR4, Dafny, Isabelle, vacuity) and fix the Java from the phase reports.
